slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to maximize total weekly profit, or is it to minimize total weekly cost while satisfying the requirement that profit be at least 3000 yuan
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and whether to maximize weekly profit.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about minimizing idle time, unused capacity, or any multi-objective tradeoff weighted by process costs. Turn 6's generic 'any other constraints or requirements' is too vague to count as targeting this hidden slot.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The only objective is to maximize total weekly profit; minimizing idle time of each process with cost-proportional weights is not part of the model.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: H2 was never asked or explicitly confirmed, and the READY_TO_MODEL summary omitted idle-time minimization while stating there were no assumptions.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 objective slot but stopped at READY_TO_MODEL with the P1 idle-time minimization objective still unasked and unconfirmed.

summary: The agent correctly clarified the primary profit-maximization objective and several key constraints, but it completely missed the secondary idle-time minimization objective and stopped modeling anyway. This leaves a material P1 hidden slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
